title: UI for activity switching provides poor feedback
line: Switching activity now shows an on-screen display with the new activity's icon and name.
explanation: When the current activity changed, the activity switcher backend only emitted a showSwitchNotification signal that nothing in Plasma listens to, so a switch by shortcut (or by accident) just made the windows vanish with no hint of what happened. Now the backend also asks plasmashell's OSD service to show the new activity's icon and name, the same popup used for volume, keyboard layout or Do Not Disturb. It is skipped at startup and while the Meta+A switcher is still held open, since the existing code already defers that case until the switch is committed.

commits.message:
activitymanager: show an OSD when switching activity

Switching activity gave no feedback besides the windows disappearing,
which made an accidental switch look like a crash. Now the switch shows
the usual on-screen display with the new activity's icon and name.

BUG: 349004

media.caption: Master: switching to the "Work" activity with the Switch to Next Activity shortcut gives no feedback at all
With the fix: Meta+A switches to "Work" and the OSD shows its icon and name
Master: activity switch by shortcut, nothing appears
With the fix: the same switch (back to "Default") shows the OSD, which then fades (the dot grid is a binary clock widget on that desktop)
